services.name: Mental Wellness & Counselling Service Variation 1
services.description: Professional mental wellness & counselling service designed for holistic well-being.

process_steps.title: Initial Consultation
process_steps.description: Assessing health goals, medical history, and current fitness level

process_steps.title: Plan Design
process_steps.description: Creating a customised programme tailored to specific needs

process_steps.title: Session Execution
process_steps.description: Conducting guided sessions with professional supervision

process_steps.title: Progress Monitoring
process_steps.description: Tracking improvements and adjusting the programme

process_steps.title: Follow-Up & Review
process_steps.description: Reviewing outcomes and setting next phase goals

aftercare: Follow post-session cool-down routines
Adhere to recommended diet and rest
services.expected_results: Improved fitness levels, reduced pain, and enhanced mental well-being.
services.important_notes: Please disclose any medical conditions before sessions begin.
services.warranty: Free rescheduling for trainer cancellations; first-session satisfaction guarantee.

faqs.question: Do I need prior experience?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is needed; programmes are tailored to all fitness levels.

faqs.question: Can sessions happen at my home?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer in-home, studio, and online sessions.

faqs.question: How soon will I see results?
faqs.answer: Most clients notice improvements within 4-6 weeks with consistent sessions.

faqs.question: Are the professionals certified?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our health professionals hold valid certifications from recognised bodies.

dos: Communicate openly about pain or discomfort during sessions.
donts: Do not skip prescribed rest days.
tips: Stay consistent — even 3 sessions per week makes a significant difference.
